documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PPS-CF
Bambu PPS-CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701T02
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
PET-CF / PPA-CF / PPS-CF / PA6 CF Carbon Fibers Filament Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties; specimens printed on an X1E at chamber 60 °C, nozzle 320 °C, bed 110 °C, 60 mm/s, 100% infill, not annealed); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 24 ± 3 MPa, elongation 0.7 ± 0.3 %, bending modulus 2460 ± 190 MPa, bending strength 36 ± 4 MPa, impact 2.8 ± 0.4 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 8230 ± 270 MPa, Z 2850 ± 160 MPa), melt index (11.48 ± 1.23 g/10 min at 320 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (214 °C, DSC 10 °C/min), heat deflection temperature 264 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.05% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue; kept as a relation), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (60 - 90 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), support ("/", none named), spool temperature resistance (145 °C) and size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing of prints (180 to 220 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, acid / alkali / organic solvent / oil resistance, flammability ("Self-extinguishing when away from fire; flame-retardant") and decomposition products.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (60 - 90 °C; the store FAQ 2.Printing Guidelines agrees) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting. The carbon-fibre wiki's suggested maximum volumetric flow rate (5.1, row "PPS-CF": "＜100 mm/s | 6 mm³/s") is not written to motion.max_flow, a printer key, for the same reason. The carbon-fibre wiki (2.6) says the H2 series and X1E have active chamber temperature control; the TDS says higher chamber and nozzle temperatures (e.g. 90 °C and 335 °C) give higher mechanical properties, especially in Z.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PPS-CF", model "T02-xx", CLP "Not classified", no PBT/vPvB substance or endocrine disruptor, the section 8 carbon-fibre handling warning (gloves when loading/unloading, cutting or sanding), conditions to avoid (fire, elevated temperatures, direct sunlight) and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI / IATA) transport. Its section 8 reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: drying (TDS and drying wiki: oven 100 - 140 °C, 8-12 h, heatbed 110 - 120 °C, 12 h / 10-12 h; carbon-fibre wiki 2.2 row "PPS-CF": convection oven 80 °C, 8–12 h, heated bed 90–100 °C, 12 h, AMS HT 85 °C, 12 h, where its PPA-CF row carries 100–140 °C); AMS HT drying (carbon-fibre wiki 85 °C, 12 h vs drying wiki "Not compatible"); spool heat limit (TDS spool temperature resistance 145 °C vs store FAQ "do not exceed 160°C to avoid damaging the spool"). The product TDS values are kept.

Printer guidance: the store page ("For X1E/H2 Series Printing Only"), the material-table wiki ("H2 Series and X1E Compatible; Not applicable to other models"; open-frame printers "Not Recommended") and the carbon-fibre wiki ("Supported only on X1E,H2D,H2S,H2C") agree; the carbon-fibre wiki does not name the H2D Pro. Every printer still needs a hardened steel nozzle for this filament.

Moisture: the carbon-fibre wiki (2.1) gives PPS-CF the same flexural strength (142 MPa) and flexural modulus (7160 MPa) dry and humid; the store page and both wikis still require drying before use and sealed storage with desiccant. Only the dry TDS values are stored.

Marketing prose proves no number: "heat deflection temperature of up to 264°C under 0.45 MPa", "can continuously operate at temperatures exceeding 200°C", "second only to PTFE (Teflon)", "insoluble in any solvent below 200°C", "moisture absorption rate of just 0.05%" and the "Parameters Comparison" section (an image) are not stored as values. The page's "UL-94 V-0 flame retardant rating" is stored only as an unverified safety.certifications row (the linked "UL 94 Test Report" was not cached; a third-party lab report would not be stored as a manufacturer spec in any case).
No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "Black (76100)" has no published hex.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/3f42b5fbe07140a48b6ce699494d423d.pdf) and a "UL 94 Test Report" (https://store.bblcdn.com/s4/default/324268b60e52447c8ffe46893d9ab50c.pdf) that were not cached and not read, so safety.certifications holds only the store page's own UL-94 V-0 claim (unverified) and is not marked not_published.
The carbon-fibre wiki links its own TDS and MSDS copies ("TDS- PPS-CF", "MSDS- PPS-CF"); they were not cached and not read. The store-linked TDS V1.0 and SDS SDS20260701T02 were read.

The store FAQ (6.Safety Tips) and the carbon-fibre wiki say the filament is not food-grade / not food-contact grade, is highly moisture-absorbent, and may carry hard microscopic splinters (wear puncture- and cut-resistant gloves and safety goggles); the FAQ (5.Annealing Prints) refers to the TDS for annealing. No registry key holds these.
